svg.title: svjeez
svg.desc: A one-minute reel for svjeez that follows the viewer's light or dark mode. In Claude Code, Claude reads the svjeez skill, writes a scene, renders frames, looks at them and ships an SVG. The scene's TSX, highlighted by @svjeez/code, streams into an editor while a preview draws each line's effect. Four shots each compose several packages: a dot map of the world with routes and dots in flight beside two counters that tick up; Mermaid text typed into an editor while it becomes a flowchart; a damped spring's equation typeset and braced, then the spring bouncing beside its plot; and one dataset drawn as a bar chart with a trend line and as a voxel skyline. "Write anything." is inked on over a field of streamlines. Three facts: zero bytes of runtime JS, one self-contained file, CSS and SMIL. The svjeez logo draws on above the install command and a row of the packages.

g.text: a real map, live routes, a number that counts
Mermaid text in, an animated diagram out
typeset the equation, then run it
one dataset, drawn as a chart and as a skyline
single-line fonts inked stroke by stroke, over a vector field
this entire video is one 441 KB SVG. no video file, no JavaScript.
